title: ohmyho.st
description: Agent-first application hosting with GitHub deployments, managed services, and a CLI, MCP tools, and typed API.
body:
ohmyho.st is an application-hosting platform for developers and coding agents. It brings GitHub deployments, databases, storage, email, domains, and usage management into one product, with interfaces an agent can use directly.

## What it does

Developers can work through a CLI, MCP tools, or a typed API instead of translating every deployment task into dashboard clicks. The platform connects application hosting with the managed services an application needs.

## Recent work

The September work opened self-service signup and improved browser-based sign-in for agent-led onboarding. Customer-chosen project addresses and renaming make projects easier to identify.

The customer-side CLI, MCP integration, TypeScript SDK, runtime, and authentication packages are published under an Apache license. The hosted platform itself is not open source.

Recent implementation also added scheduled-function run history, time-limited direct PostgreSQL access, hosting-region selection, isolated application builds, and managed email. The product website now separates editorial content from application code and provides clearer comparison, migration, and coding-agent guides.

## Why it matters

An agent that can write an application also needs a clear way to deploy it, inspect it, and manage its dependencies. This project focuses on making those operational steps explicit and usable without hiding them behind a chat interface.

[Read the documentation](https://docs.ohmyho.st/).
